sermon.title: Clash of the Horns and Carpenters Part 2
sermon.series: Clash of the Horns and Carpenters
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: Spirit-filled carpenters preached and Felix trembled. Modern horns include false religion, fascism and nationalism, America’s inconsistent equality, liberalism, hedonism, denominational splits and evolutionary claims. The world rejects Bible morality and does what is right in its own eyes.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

chunks.short_answer: Filled with the Holy Ghost, they preached; Felix trembled; scattered believers kept their character.
chunks.text:
They were filled with the Holy Ghost. All three of these people were filled with the Holy Ghost, including the church members. They preached the word. See, they didn’t preach their opinions. They preached the word. They preached what Jesus preached. They did miracles. And their message was repent and bring forth fruit worthy of repentance. That was their message. The message hadn’t changed. From John to Jesus to the apostles, the message hadn’t changed. Felix, when Paul stood before Felix and preached to Felix, righteousness, self-control, and judgment. What did he preach? Righteousness, self-control, judgment.

Felix trembled. He shook. See, fulfilling what Zechariah said, these carpenters that are building the temple will put these people in fear. Are you there, church? This is powerful stuff. Hallelujah. Very powerful. See how powerful the word of God is? See, Paul didn’t have power. He just simply spoke what God had said to speak and God backed it up and shook Felix his whole being. And Felix shook because he rejected. He didn’t want to repent. And I’ve seen atheists shake and I’ve seen, you know, they they they reject. They want to get away. They don’t want this thing to be real.

Felix didn’t repent that day. Church members They were scattered by persecution of these horns. And everywhere they went, what did they do? They preached the word, not their opinion. They preached the word. Why were they scattered in the first place? Because they preached the word and lived the word. That’s why they were being persecuted. They didn’t change their lifestyle or their message when they had to run away from the persecution. They just kept living for God and preaching. They didn’t change their word and their lifestyle so they could stay in Jerusalem and in Judea, you know, to be with their family and everybody accept them and everything’s okay.

No, they had to run, but they ran with the same character that that got them persecuted in the first place. Now, that’s good preaching. And there is a time to run. There is a time to retreat, but there is no time to compromise the word of God. Colossians 3:9, we are labors together with God. You are God’s building. So who are the carpenters? The apostles, the ministers. Who are the building? We are the building. They are the carpenters. By the grace of God given unto me as a wise master builder. I am not just a carpenter. I am a skillful carpenter. Paul said, I know what I’m doing.

God is working with me to work on you. How many know we need those kind of ministers. That build God’s people, not flatter them. The church needs built. Now, the spiritual powers behind the horns. We showed it to you. Here’s another one. Acts 26:18. When he sent Paul to preach the gospel, he sent him to turn them from darkness to light and from the power of who? Satan to the power of God receiving forgiveness of sins and an inheritance in Jesus Christ. So see there is a spiritual power behind people’s opposition to God his people and his word and we have to understand that and carpenters go after the source of the power the result.

Therefore those who were scattered went everywhere preaching the word.
